source.notes: POST /sap/bc/adt/datapreview/ddic?rowNumber=5&ddicEntityName=DEMO_CDS_PARA, empty request body, 200. THE SILENT-EMPTY CASE, and the reason parsePreviewBody now reads dataPreview:message. DEMO_CDS_PARA is a CDS view WITH PARAMETERS. The endpoint does not refuse it with 4xx: it answers HTTP 200, <dataPreview:totalRows>0</dataPreview:totalRows>, ZERO <dataPreview:columns> elements, and one <dataPreview:message dataPreview:text="Data preview not supported for view with parameters" dataPreview:severity="I"/>. Structurally that is INDISTINGUISHABLE from a transparent table that happens to hold no rows, and before this capture the tool rendered it as one — "EMPTY: ... exists and was read successfully, but returned no rows. That is a genuinely empty result, not a failure and not a truncation." That claim was false: no read happened. The message element is the only thing on the wire that says so, which makes it load-bearing rather than decorative. Note that removeNSPrefix:true strips the prefix from ATTRIBUTES too, so dataPreview:text/dataPreview:severity arrive as @_text/@_severity. The same body shape (byte-identical message element, severity "I") was captured on the same run for ICHARCTERISTICT, an SAP-shipped parameterised view, confirming this is endpoint behaviour and not a property of the DEMO_ object; that second capture is not stored as its own cassette because it pins nothing this one does not. Anonymisation: appliance.server is the repo's standing pseudonym for the A4H ApplicationServerName. The appliance host name, its container IPv4 and the appliance URL are deliberately absent; Authorization / Cookie / X-CSRF-Token request-header values are replaced with placeholders. Response bytes are unmodified.
